Requirement: Hide every model that lacks a current qualification result for the candidate build
Harness mapping: caos/server/run.py::build_provider + engine/provider.py::ProviderQualification (production refuses an unqualified binding); qualify.py verdict aggregates only results bound to the current build/binding/corpus (scoring.aggregate current view)
Notes: The catalog is one binding; a binding without a QUALIFIED verdict is never served in production (Task 5). Live: BLOCKED EXTERNAL until the live matrix passes.

Requirement: Pin the exact provider and model ID and provider-reported version and parameters and adapter version at run start
Harness mapping: engine/provider.py::ProviderIdentity (stored on runs/artifacts/snapshots, Task 5B); every qualification result carries binding = identity.as_dict() (qualify.py run_cell)
Notes: Result field binding: provider_name, model, provider_version, adapter_version, parameter_context_digest, identity_digest.

Requirement: Record the active provider and model and never a default from another adapter
Harness mapping: RecordingProvider.identity is the built provider's own identity; qualify.py cell_settings refuses mixed credentials (CREDENTIALS_PRESENT / BINDING_CONFLICT)

Requirement: Run three cold repetitions for every agent-backed matrix cell
Harness mapping: qualify.py matrix spawns one fresh process per (cell, repetition); POLICY.live_repetitions = 3; scoring.aggregate requires `repetitions` passes per required cell
Notes: Host control runs one repetition by default (`--repetitions` overrides); the live policy is three.

Requirement: Require every repetition to pass schema and evidence and citation and budget and security and audit gates
Harness mapping: scoring.score_cell: outcome (static route), citations, unsupported_claims, budget, injection dimensions; a cell passes only when every applicable dimension passes; aggregate never averages
Notes: Schema and audit gates are host-enforced (invariant 9; audit chain) and surface as run refusals in the outcome dimension.

Requirement: Compare model conclusions to the pack's permitted and forbidden conclusions
Harness mapping: answer_key.expected_facts (permitted) and forbidden_conclusions; scoring.score_facts and score_unsupported_claims (forbidden hits)
Notes: Draft keys are host-control attested; analyst approval is BLOCKED EXTERNAL (C17–C22 also need benchmark conclusions).

Requirement: Require 100% citation resolution and 0 unsupported material claims in accepted output
Harness mapping: scoring.score_citations (every evidence_ref admitted and delivered) and score_unsupported_claims (forbidden 0; every non-year figure in Audit Summary/Analysis traceable to delivered evidence, a calculation record or the key)
Notes: Canonical model-table modules are exempt only under host control (fixture tables; recorded per result as exempt_modules); live runs exempt nothing.

Requirement: Require 100% traceability for numbers and units and currencies and periods and definitions
Harness mapping: score_unsupported_claims numeric traceability + score_facts per-fact source/period binding; calculation records ride verified digests (runtime _validate_calculation_refs)
Notes: Units/currency/period are fields on every expected fact and are compared by match string against the cited block.

Requirement: Require all methodology registers and headings and frontmatter and bounded fields
Harness mapping: Host: canonical envelope validation (invariant 9, test_modules_spec); harness: outcome dimension fails on AGENT_OUTPUT_INVALID
Notes: Task 11 adds no new register check; the harness surfaces the typed refusal.

Requirement: Require explicit gaps when evidence is missing or conflicted
Harness mapping: answer_key.conflicts scored by scoring.score_conflicts against the Gaps & Conflicts sections; C02 (refusal), C03, C05, C11, C16 packs

Requirement: Require the strongest supported counterargument and the condition under which it wins
Harness mapping: Not scored by the harness; analyst rubric item on the C17/C21/C22 benchmark conclusions
Notes: Requires the independently authored conclusions (owner: independent analyst).

Requirement: Require downside reasoning to identify cause and first break and transmission and consequence and observable trigger
Harness mapping: Not scored by the harness; analyst rubric item on the C17/C21 benchmark conclusions
Notes: Requires the independently authored conclusions (owner: independent analyst).

Requirement: Prevent a model from changing host-owned identity and quality status and confidence inputs and authority fields
Harness mapping: C12 injection dimension: host_identity, identity_digest, system_digests, budget_limits equal between control and injected runs; test_injection_spec pins the host refusals
Notes: Live C12 cell exercises the exact provider path when credentials exist (BLOCKED EXTERNAL today).

Requirement: Prevent a model from invoking undeclared tools or tool arguments
Harness mapping: C12 injection dimension: tool_calls ⊆ {read_evidence, run_methodology_calculation} and tools_by_module equal; runtime call_tool refuses unknown tools (AGENT_OUTPUT_INVALID)

Requirement: Reject mixed text and tool output where the provider contract permits only one action
Harness mapping: Runtime loop contract (engine/loop.py; test_provider_tools.py); harness outcome dimension surfaces the refusal

Requirement: Reject truncated and duplicate-key and non-finite and oversized and extra-field and malformed final output
Harness mapping: Runtime canonical envelope (invariant 9; test_modules_spec, test_injection_spec smuggled fields); harness outcome dimension

Requirement: Permit one bounded repair only where the contract allows it and disable evidence tools during repair
Harness mapping: Runtime repair allowance (runtime.py repair_state; test_runtime_calculations.py); harness records provider_calls per run

Requirement: Preserve assistant and tool-result ordering across a provider continuation
Harness mapping: Runtime loop (test_provider_tools.py); RecordingProvider observes the ordered messages of every request

Requirement: Map timeouts and connection errors and rate limits and policy refusals and authentication failures and malformed usage and unknown stop reasons to typed outcomes
Harness mapping: Adapters (test_anthropic_provider.py, test_openrouter_provider.py); harness outcome dimension compares the typed error code with the key
Notes: Live-path exercise of each failure class is BLOCKED EXTERNAL (credentials).

Requirement: Keep provider error bodies and prompts and keys and headers and secrets out of durable events and client responses
Harness mapping: observability spec (test_observability_spec.py); qualification results carry digests and ids only — no prompt, no evidence text (qualify.py run_cell result shape)

Requirement: Prove estimated OpenRouter reservations remain conservative at minimum and typical and maximum request shapes
Harness mapping: test_openrouter_provider.py margin tests; the harness refuses OpenRouter as a live binding (run.py build_provider: development-only)
Notes: OpenRouter is never a qualification binding (CLAUDE.md known gap).

Requirement: Reject a model that cannot complete any required full-depth module
Harness mapping: scoring.aggregate: a pathway is qualified only by a passing positive cell with proves_pathway; a refusal never proves a pathway; one failed required cell → UNQUALIFIED

Requirement: Revoke qualification after model or adapter or methodology or system prompt or schema or policy change
Harness mapping: scoring.aggregate discards results whose binding_view (identity_digest, commit, methodology build id and manifest digest, corpus digest, policy digest) differs from the current view (stale_results)
Notes: The identity digest already folds adapter and parameter/policy context (Task 5).

Requirement: Make model qualification expire on a declared review date even when the model name has not changed
Harness mapping: Every result carries expires_at = date + POLICY.review_days (90); scoring.aggregate drops expired results (expired_results); engine/provider.py ensure_current refuses an expired qualification record at run time

Requirement: Publish the qualified-model catalog and its evidence to test owners
Harness mapping: qualify.py verdict prints the binding verdict with per-pathway status and blocking cells; the protected workflow retains the evidence directory as a build artifact (enterprise-qualification.yml)
Notes: Publication to test owners is the ER-L3 loop's log plus the retained artifact; live evidence BLOCKED EXTERNAL.
